School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences
Admissions
Established in 2005, the School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (SPMS) offers undergraduate degree programmes and graduate programmes in two disciplines: the Mathematical Sciences and Physics and Applied Physics.
For all admissions-related queries, please click here. After submitting the online form, an NTU admissions officer will reply to you as soon as possible.
Undergraduate Programmes
For the NTU Undergraduate Admissions guide, click here. The representative grade profiles for admission into our programmes (and other NTU programmes) can be viewed here.

Graduate Programmes
PhD in Mathematical Sciences
Site Page for Mathematics PhD Programme
PhD in Physics
Site page for Physics PhD Programme
MSc in Precision Scientific Instrumentation
A postgraduate programme in the principles and operation of state-of-the-art technical equipment used in applied physics and related fields.
MSc in Analytics
An interdisciplinary postgraduate programme in advanced data analysis methods for business, finance, and industry.
MSc in Financial Technology
A postgraduate programme on disruptive financial technologies such as robo-advisors, blockchain systems, and machine learning.
MSc in Modelling and Simulation
A postgraduate programme that provides students with a solid foundation in computational modelling, artificial intelligence, specialised applications, and both research and industrial practices.
MSc in Cybersecurity (Applied Cryptography)
The Master of Science in Cybersecurity (MSCS) at NTU is a coursework-based graduate degree jointly offered by the College of Computing and Data Science (CCDS) and the School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (SPMS).
